schemaVersion.description: Generator schema version, always the component id.

title.description: Short title for students in plain text.

id.description: Lowercase kebab stage id, 40 characters or fewer.

body.description: Who votes, in the page words, 1 to 60 characters, for example States.

total.description: Page-stated total voters, integer 1 to 100000. It occurs in totalQuote.

numerator.description: Fraction numerator; 0 is the absent sentinel when the rule is not fraction.

denominator.description: Fraction denominator; 0 is the absent sentinel when the rule is not fraction.

statedCount.description: Page-stated required count, or 0 when the page states none; required for rule count.

sourceId.description: Id of the source the quote was copied from.

quote.description: Exact characters copied from the source, no ellipsis, 150 characters or fewer. It states the rule words and/or statedCount.

totalQuote.description: Exact characters copied from the source, no ellipsis, 150 characters or fewer. It contains total; it may equal quote.

stages.description: Stages that must all pass, 1 to 3.

id.description: Lowercase kebab scenario id, 40 characters or fewer.

label.description: Scenario label in plain text, 1 to 80 characters.

items.description: Yes votes for one stage, integer within that stage total.

yes.description: One yes count per stage, in stage order.

scenarios.description: Try-it vote counts, 1 to 3; engine inputs, not page claims.
